verdict.rationale: The evidence covers GitHub Projects' planning features: table, board and roadmap views, custom fields, workflows and the API. It also notes that an issue can be assigned to Copilot to delegate work, but that is adjacent delegation, not reviewing agent code changes. Nothing documents line-level code review, commenting from a mobile app, or the agent iterating on review feedback.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can review AI agent code changes and comment on specific lines from a mobile app, then have the agent iterate
